notes.title: DreadHaunt 1.0 Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

We're thrilled to announce that DreadHaunt 1.0 is finally here! After months of hard work, dedication, and countless sleepless nights, we're excited to bring you the full vision of a fun yet scary experience.

This update marks a significant milestone for our team. We've poured our hearts and souls into creating a truly haunting experience, and we can't wait to see what you think.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

[h1]What's New in 1.0?[/h1]

[h2]New Gameplay Modes: Single Player Campaign[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/c1b8e7ad1ee4eaba9a41b02b44ffca8531011c62.gif[/img]
Experience the thrills of DreadHaunt, if you dare, in Single Player mode, And dive deeper into the DreadHaunt universe with an expanded lore.

[h2]Expanded Character Roster[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/bc528a019a18950415d750d291efbfca4c234bf8.gif[/img]
DreadHaunt 1.0 features a wider selection of playable characters, both Agents and the Spectromorphs will be unlocked as you play.

[h2][b](Free)[/b] Season Pass: Pilot[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5b790f03cc736971d180b0176f0ada05afc3be72.jpg[/img]
In addition to new modes, agents, and Spectromorphs, you will also rewarded with more agent costumes, lore entries, titles, alternate NPC ghosts, and many more!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
We couldn't have made it this far without your incredible support. Thank you for joining us on this terrifying journey. We can't wait to see what horrors await you in DreadHaunt 1.0.

Thank you for your support, and get haunting!

- Digital Happiness :DH

notes.title: Red Lantern and Gold Coins - DreadHaunt Update 20240212
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/5a0bf7efea472448e26d4283efffecd923b86b91.png[/img]

Greetings, Agents!

First of all, happy Lunar New Year! And now, the HQ is presenting news regarding DreadHaunt’s latest update, just in time for this festivities!


[h2]Seasonal Environment – CNY[/h2]

Embrace the spirit of the Lunar New Year with the new seasonal ornament! We hope that this seasonal environment will freshen up your haunting sessions. We even managed to snap some footage directly from the field.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/e539ad057f0ae07ccb750d5a5353ad99499acdf5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/56797effdfd5768a62fb2436a7002d8da5bc4d30.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/36f67341665fee32f2548ab3af5b6f6e376f0dd2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42513571/b6f56fbad7faa8340811599c67dda00b88916299.jpg[/img][/url]


[h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2]

As usual, We squashed some bugs and fine-tuned several aspects to ensure smooth gameplay. However, don’t hesitate to reach out if you have feedback and suggestions!


[h2]Future Update Sneak Peek[/h2]

Based on the timeline that we shared, the single-player mode is in the works. We’re also working on the game economy like XP accumulation and cosmetics rewards.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1855580/extras/content_release_plan_fixed.jpg?t=1703069105[/img]

That is all for now. Thank you for your continued support for DreadHaunt!

notes.title: DreadHaunt Update 2023-12-20
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33371531/07d380d2395eacdd707e403d3e5806bfd69af98a.png[/img]
Good day, Agents.

We have updated DreadHaunt to version 20231218, and these are notable details that the HQ want to share:

[h2]Post-Session Results Screen[/h2]

After each session, you’ll be presented with an eye-catching post-result screen. Showing who’s the possessed one, who survived (or didn’t), and how many points you racked up during the mission. 

[h2](Ongoing) Audio Updates[/h2]

We decided to overhaul the Audio System including BGM & SFX assets. You will notice a few changes during gameplay

[h2](Ongoing) Controller Support[/h2]

Controller support is available in very early stage. If you the controller-wielding type of agent, we are looking forward to hear your experiences!

[h2]Bug Fixes, Here and There[/h2]

- Added subtitle size option to Settings.
- Spectro damage effect +15%
- Kunti attack charge 25 -> 28.75
- Asih attack charge 10 -> 11.5
- Prevent drop tools while opening voter
- BugFix: Kunti attack charge hit multiple times
- Add condition to disable host quit button when in game
- add descriptions to sprectro skills
- fix mouse cursor not reappearing during waiting for players

[h2]Known Bugs/Glitches[/h2]

- BGM not playing on Versus Mode
- etc.

[h2]Sneak Peek of Future Contents[/h2]

We have a Content Update Plans on the DreadHaunt store page, check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1855580/DreadHaunt/

Last but not least, if you have any suggestions or experienced bugs or glitches about the game, Feel free to reach us out on Steam Community Forum and our official discord server at discord.gg/dreaduniverse

notes.title: DreadHaunt Playtest is open during Steam Scream Fest!
notes.content:
Hi Agents! 

To commemorate Steam Scream Fest, DreadHaunt Playtest is open until 1 November! 

With this playtest phase. There are some gameplay features you can try, which are:

- Gameplay modifier tarot system. choose several modifiers that will change the vibe of every game session. 

- Preview of the session ending screen and merit points distribution.

- Reworked several possessed abilities.

- QoL update: character & environment polishing. bugfixes, etc

I hope you enjoy the playtest! If you have feedback go to the steam community hub or discord.gg/dreaduniverse. Also, bring your friends to survive together and wishlist DreadHaunt!

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2021! 1.1.5 update released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
2020 it’s a really challenging time for all of us, some of our plans and schedules are not well implemented during this unique time. And yet we are very grateful with all of your support, DreadOut 2 is slowly improving and the responses are well received (with 58% mixed reviews during our rocky launch and now 71% mostly positive). 

With 2021 approaching closer as well, we would like to [b]wish you Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2021![/b] [b]May you & your loved ones be blessed with joyful heart, happiness in your home, peace in your soul and joy in your life.[/b] Today and always.

Today we have updated [b]DreadOut 2 to version 1.1.5[/b] that contains some minor bug fixes and the most part are adding some new localizations as well. We are adding Hungarian and Spain localization in this update. Shoot out to our friend [b]Brechler Zsolt[/b] who helps us with the Hungarian translation, and [b]Alberto Aniorte R[/b] for Spanish translation. They both are supporting us since the first DreadOut, really appreciate their help! 

The detailed patch are listed in the notes below;
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/945710/discussions/0/1751275426755601120/]1.1.5 patch notes[/url]

Stay tuned for more information, we hope you enjoy DreadOut 2 as much as we do. Be well, stay safe, and Cheers!  Again, thank you for your endless support!

All the best, 
Digital Happiness

==============================================================================

Halo semua,
2020 merupakan tahun yang penuh tantangan bagi kita semua, beberapa perencanaan dan skedul kami tidak bisa terimplementasi dengan baik. Namun kami tetap bersyukur dengan dukungan kalian semua. DreadOut 2 secara perlahan membaik dengan dukungan serta respon positif yang terus kami dapatkan (58% mixed reviews saat perilisan awal sampai dengan saat ini di 71% positif reviews)

Menjelang datangnya tahun 2021 tidak lama lagi, kami juga mengucapkan [b]Selamat Hari Natal dan Tahun baru 2021[/b] bagi yang merayakan. [b]Semoga kita semua diberkati dengan kebahagiaan, keriaan dan kesehatan yang baik. [/b]

Hari ini juga kita telah merilis [b]DreadOut 2 versi 1.1.5[/b] yang berisi beberapa perbaikan revisi minor dan yang paling utama adalah memberikan tambahan subtitle Spanyol dan Hungaria. Terima kasih kepada teman kita Brechler Zsolt, dan Alberto Aniorte R untuk bantuan translasi Hungaria dan Spanyol. Mereka berdua telah mendukung kami sejak DreadOut pertama.

Rekapan tambahan dari patch adalah sebagai berikut;
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/945710/discussions/0/1751275426755601120/]1.1.5 patch notes[/url]

Tetap bersama kami untuk mendapatkan informasi pembaharuan selanjutnya. Semoga kalian menikmati bermain DreadOut 2, seperti kami pun menikmati saat membuatnya. Tetap sehat, semangat dan sekali lagi terima kasih atas dukungan kalian!

Salam hangat selalu and always :p
Digital Happiness

notes.title: DreadOut 2 version 1.1.4 Available Now
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
Thank you for your patience and support. After listening to your feedback and suggestions, today we’re releasing [b]DreadOut 2 version 1.1.4[/b], sort of like [b]Director’s Cut Update[/b] that contained mainly from our cut contents and also some improvement based on our user’s feedback as well.

Kindly check out our Official Update trailer;
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=auGCPvxIfZ0

Below are the highlights from our updates;

[b]New Story campaign update[/b]
[list]
[*] New Alternate Ending
[*] New Irisphone app for costumes changing
[*] New costumes
[*] New Boss
[/list]
[b]Free DLC DreadOut: The Untolds comic[/b]
[b]Several gameplay improvements and boss battle tweaks[/b]

And the detail change fixed list:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/945710/discussions/0/1751275426755601120/]Changes and fixed list[/url]

Please also note that for now;
[list]
[*] Our free DLC will only be available in Indonesia, English, and Russia. We will continue to update with another language support.
[*] As for the base game itself, some Chinese text is still missing for translation, we’re still working for the fix as we speak. 
[*] We also plan to support Hungarian and Spanish language. Please stay tuned for the upcoming updates.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update and have the best experience playing DreadOut 2 as it deserved :)

All the best,
DH


P.S. Our Independence sales will be coming at August 16th with a great discount ^_^ 


==============================================================================

Halo semuanya,

Setelah mendengarkan input dan masukan dari kalian, hari ini kami merilis [b]DreadOut 2 versi 1.1.4[/b], bisa dibilang seperti [b]Director’s Cut Update[/b] yang berisikan konten2 yang seharusnya tersedia di versi sebelumnya, namun terpaksa kita relakan untuk dipotong atas berbagai pertimbangan:) Konten yang tersedia juga merupakan perbaikan dari input dan saran kalian.

notes.title: DreadOut 2 Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Recently, we have an update to further improving DreadOut 2 experience, eliminating further newly founded bugs as well.

This update also contains a major change in terms of Achievement trophy, where we removed BURIK achievement as we have told you in previous DreadOut 2 Version 1.0.1 Update patch notes. The BURIK (an anagram of RUBIK) was a Rubik's cube player need to solve and tied to our achievement. Alas, it just brings headache to all of us, both the solver and the game (as some of you might have experienced, it occasionally missing in the level and shown back upon reloading checkpoints).

We do not have an exact answer as to why it happened so randomly except that it possibly related to the collision and numerical stability of the game engine, hence we removed it completely (both the cube and the achievement). The version is bumped to 1.1.0 from 1.0.1 because of this decision. Hope you understand.

For more complete patch notes, see below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/945710/discussions/0/1751275426755601120/

Along with this update, we’re still open to any other reports that can potentially reduce your experience while playing DreadOut 2. Stay tuned for more updates from us, as we’re moving into polishing, balancing and tweaking some detail parts that need to be addressed as well.

Thank you for your patience and kind support.
DH
